The [background page](../../background.qmd) presents the original study, the SCORE replication and the five reanalyses of the robustness study of SCORE [Multi100\; @AczelEtAl2026InvestigatingAnalyticalRobustness]. The short format takes Tasks 1 to 4, and you do them in the deck of the session, whose slides run R inside your browser with the data already in place. The [browser lab](../../lab.qmd) holds the same tasks and is the fallback if the deck does not load.

## The tasks

The session takes four of the five numbered tasks of the exercise, in the cells of its deck.

### Task 1 – The setup check

Wait for the engine of the deck to finish downloading, then run the setup cell.

### Task 2 – The estimand statement

Write the **estimand statement** behind the claim, in the chat. It says which comparison is made (Hispanic names against which names), which emails are counted (the replies, or every delivered email), and which outcome is compared. The [specification menu](../../menu.qmd) gives the template.

### Task 3 – The reproduction

Choose one of the five analysts in the table above and reproduce the analysis from the public file of the OAs, `housing_original.csv` ([codebook](../../data/housing_original_codebook.md)), in the cells of that analyst. Then find out why your number is what it is. A reproduction depends on the defaults and the codings of the software as well as on the data and the model.

### Task 4 – The menu

This task is **exploratory**: nothing in it is preregistered, and you may look, change your mind and try again. Try several specifications from the [specification menu](../../menu.qmd) with `try_spec()`, one decision at a time, and note which choices move the estimate and which barely touch it. Then choose the one that you would defend and run it once more, so that it is your last try, because the slides place it among the `r nrow(curve)` specifications of the curve. The session sends nothing to the class chart.

### Task 5 – Declaration and report

The session stops before this task, in which you choose **one** specification and complete a preregistration block before you run it, and before the class chart. The page [After the session](after.qmd) says where to take both up.
